scope: Thursday only — Jacksonville Jaguars at Baltimore Ravens, November 5, 2026

historical_sample.label: L10
historical_sample.definition: 10 most recent completed qualifying regular-season games

historical_cutoff.rule: Completion of final scheduled game of Week 8

methodology.selection: Choose available FanDuel alternate whose American odds are closest to -250; ties select more negative price.
methodology.floor: Immediately lower available alternate threshold than CORE.
methodology.ceiling: Immediately higher available alternate threshold than CORE, regardless of historical HR.
methodology.historical_hr: Hits / exact locked Stage 1 L10; threshold counted as achieved when historical value >= alternate threshold.

core_selection.selection_rule: Eligible price closest to -250 within inclusive -350 to -150 band

floor_selection.rule: Immediately lower available alternate threshold than CORE

ceiling_selection.rule: Immediately higher available alternate threshold than CORE

records.stage3_candidate_reason: Has a valid FanDuel CORE alternate and adjacent Floor/Ceiling structure for later evaluation.

records.stage3_exclusion_reason: No FanDuel alternate market available for this Stage 1 market; no alternate threshold can be evaluated.
